title: French Apricot Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful French-inspired stew made with tender apricots and a hint of warm spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the carrots and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the apricots, vegetable broth, cinnamon, and nutmeg.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
